voice.text: In Grimoire, you're the only developer at a small booking company.
Problems walk in as tickets. People tell you what went wrong, in their own words. Not what to do.
So you investigate, and you fix it with real code: SQL, JavaScript, or PHP.
Your code really runs, and the office acts out what it changed. Priya gets her room back, and you close the ticket.
But skills fade. Days later, an old problem comes back, just before you would have forgotten how to fix it.
Prove your skills, win new clients, and watch the company grow: labs, gyms, schools, and more.
Grimoire. Learn to code by running the company.
